application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1,T2,T3,T4 (Lime)-Removal of 2 metres, leaving 2.5 metres finishing height.
T5 (Lime)- Re-pollard to old points, remove epicormic growths, prune from buildings/trees. Removal of 2 metres, leaving 2.5 metres finishing height.
T6 (Lime)- Fell as close to ground level as possible. Apply systemic herbicide to stump to prevent re-growth.
T7, T8, T9, T10 (Lime)-Re-pollard to old points, remove epicormic growths. Removal of 2 metres, leaving 2.5 metres finishing height.
T11 (Lime)-Re-pollard to old points, remove epicormic growths and prune from building/structure/tree. Removal of 2m, leaving 2.5m  finishing height.
A Group-Raise low canopy to 4m  (summary)
decision_conditions: The works specified in this application should only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998: 2010 'Tree Work Recommendations'.
